newsitem.title: UK: Rolls Royce jv gets $125 mln Colombia deal.
newsitem.headline: Rolls Royce jv gets $125 mln Colombia deal.

text.p: Rolls-Royce said on Tuesday that one of its joint ventures, International Aero Engines, has been awarded a $125 million contract to supply engines for airliners for Colombian airline, Aerolineas Centrales de Colombia S.A.
Rolls-Royce's share of the contract would be around $40 million.
The contract is for up to eight Airbus Industrie A320 airliners, four of which are firm contracts while the other four are optional.
ACES would take delivery of the first two A320s in November, the third and fourth aircraft being scheduled for July and October 1998.

The new Airbus fleet would progressively replace the airline's Boeing 727s on its Colombian domestic network connecting Medellin to Bogota, Cali, Cartagena and Baranquilla as well as on international routes to the United States.
